comparison_disclaimer: ALM r14 uses LoRA r=64 adapter (low-rank product ΔW = α/r · B·A) over Mistral-7B base; CLM v4 350m uses full fine-tune over 530.99M decoder. Direct numeric comparison is a CATEGORY MISMATCH. Normalized ratio (ΔW_F / W_init_F) is the only honest cross-comparison.

raw_ratio_clm_over_alm.interpretation: CLM raw ΔW_F is 15.22× ALM r14 — but this is dominated by full-rank vs rank-64 (4096/64 = 64× more degrees of freedom per layer in ALM gate_proj alone), so raw multiplier is near-meaningless.

qualitative_consistency_check.verdict: MLP-gate family dominance is preserved in CLM (gate/up/down all in top-4 by absolute), matching ALM r14 pattern. q_proj prominence in CLM is stronger than ALM (CLM rel 0.163 vs ALM rel-equivalent ranking 5/7), indicating CLM training pushed attention-query geometry harder.
